scope: Local source, unit, tenant/API, static migration, production-build, and Chromium evidence correcting fixed-family source watermarks to use immutable receipt classification rather than provider transport topics. No customer data, PostgreSQL migration execution, provider credential/request, source-system write, protected staging, or production environment was used.

priorEvidence.purpose: The immediately preceding immutable 49-migration, 481-test watermark artifact. Its strict tenant/API/browser evidence remains historical, but its direct external_object_type family-aggregation premise is withdrawn by this corrective artifact.

correction.invalidPremise: Provider source_events.external_object_type normally stores transport topics such as orders/snapshot, orders/updated, payment_intent.succeeded, and refund.updated rather than the six product-facing families.
correction.whyPriorFocusedEvidenceWasInsufficient: The ADR 0046 mapper fixtures supplied family labels directly and therefore bypassed normal provider ingestion.
correction.oneToManyCase: One authenticated Shopify orders/snapshot receipt always classifies to order and additionally classifies to refund_transaction only when the exact validated payload contains refund transactions.
correction.correctionMethod: Accepted superseding ADR, additive migration, classification-aware writers, conservative reader state, tests, and a new immutable artifact.

decision.supersedesAdr0046Scope: source-family storage/query premise and watermark read mechanism
decision.publicApiChangeKind: The existing object-watermark discriminated union adds classification_unavailable.
decision.sourceEventWriteBehaviorChange: One append-only classification row is committed per operational provider or CSV source event.

fixedFamilyContract.meaningOfStableAbsentBalanceFamily: An honest V1 source gap, not processing-fee evidence.

databaseContract.classificationRepresentation: One complete non-empty text array per source event.
databaseContract.noBackfillReason: A legacy Shopify snapshot topic cannot prove refund presence, and an unbounded object-store scan is unsafe in a schema migration.

tenantAndReadContract.classifiedRead: Join classification to the same tenant source event, unnest the fixed array, and compute independent maximum source and receipt timestamps by connection and family.
tenantAndReadContract.unclassifiedRead: Detect operational source events lacking the exact supported classifier version; exclude only exact Shopify privacy topics.
tenantAndReadContract.oneUnclassifiedOperationalReceiptBehavio: Every expected family on that connection is classification_unavailable.
tenantAndReadContract.browserMalformedResponseBehavior: Fail the connector-health view closed without partial connection rendering.

migrationAndRolloutContract.migration0048RetainedPurpose: Raw source-event tenant/connection/topic/time access path only.
migrationAndRolloutContract.firstProtectedDeploymentRequirement: Start clean with only classification-aware writers after migration 0049.
migrationAndRolloutContract.futurePopulatedUpgradeRequirement: Inventory gaps and use a separately reviewed, bounded, checksum/object-integrity-verified repair with interruption/retry rehearsal; require zero gaps before claiming complete coverage.
migrationAndRolloutContract.rollback: Roll back API/web/worker together and leave the additive index and table in place while any classification-aware reader or writer may remain.

limitations: The checked-in PostgreSQL/RLS integration paths were not executed because no local PostgreSQL runtime or .env was available. Transactional migration execution, restricted-role classification writes/reads, append-only denial, provider/CSV atomicity, tenant concealment, and classified/gap query behavior remain source-defined on the 50-migration chain.

Migration 0049 performs no legacy backfill. Any existing operational event or event written by an old image remains classification_unavailable until a separately reviewed bounded object-integrity-checked repair proves zero gaps. No such populated repair exists or is claimed.
The current Stripe adapter does not ingest balance transactions. The stable family exposes that known V1 gap; it is not evidence that Stripe fee data is available.

No provider credential, Shopify/Stripe sandbox request, real provider pagination, webhook delivery, gap-repair completeness, provider outage, source-system write, protected staging, or production traffic was exercised.

Independent source and receipt maxima can come from different classified receipts. They do not prove normalization success, raw-object retention, provider completeness, current availability, reconciliation correctness, or financial state.

Representative classification-table storage growth, provider/CSV write contention, classified and unclassified query plans/latency, tenant timing, populated migration behavior, mixed-image rehearsal, backup/restore, WAL/replica impact, and protected alerting remain unverified.

A fresh Drizzle generate-no-drift result is not claimed for the custom migration chain. The classification schema and migration are aligned by reviewed source, static migration assertions, strict typecheck, and migration integrity validation; live PostgreSQL remains required.
